# Vetta 0.6.26
<!-- release-status: released 2026-11-25 -->

## English

### Fixes

- Agents and team conversations no longer disappear with "Agent Team configuration could not be loaded" after a restart if you built agents from a persona like Master. Nothing was lost; they come back after updating.

### 修复

- 基于「主控」等人设自建过智能体后，重启不再报错并让智能体与团队对话消失；数据未丢失，升级后自动恢复。
